title: Foo Bar Fix Slow Query
description: Optimize a slow analytical query against a 100M-row ClickHouse events table so it runs in under 100ms, without dropping or mutating the source data.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must optimize a slow ClickHouse query so it runs under 100ms without changing the underlying data.

tasks.description: Reduce the median latency of the canonical query in /workspace/query.sql below 100ms while preserving the source data and the query result set.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse running with a 100M-row analytics.events table sorted by event_id (deliberately misaligned with the canonical filter on region + event_ts). The canonical slow query lives at /workspace/query.sql; the agent optimizes the storage / indexing / aggregation layer to satisfy it.
